description: Main frontend source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game, defining app theme, game state management, AI logic, and UI components.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget applying themes and routing to GamePage.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Immutable class representing the current state of the Tic Tac Toe game board and logic.

classes.name: SimpleAI
classes.description: Implements a simple AI for the game with move prioritization.

classes.name: GamePage
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the game UI, logic, and user interactions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the app that runs TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: GameState.initial
methods.description: Creates an initial empty game state.

methods.name: GameState.copyWith
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified property overrides.

methods.name: GameState.getWinnerIndexTriplet
methods.description: Finds starting index of winning triplet if any.

methods.name: GameState.evaluateWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner based on current board.

methods.name: GameState.isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw.

methods.name: SimpleAI.chooseMove
methods.description: Decides the AI's move based on current game state.

methods.name: _findWinningMove
methods.description: Helper to find winning/blocking move for a player.

methods.name: _Score
methods.description: Holds scoring info for AI and stats.

methods.name: GamePage
methods.description: Main game screen widget with game logic.
